name: Phosphor field / life between pixels
art: Use the actual procedural signal and cell-mask construction as the baseline. A dot texture placed over a blurry static line does not match this material.

properties.label: One broad signal display
properties.text: Stretch one broad luminous display plate beneath a short technical heading on a nearly black ground. Keep small mode and density controls below the field instead of enclosing it in a generic metrics dashboard.

properties.label: Signal sampled through stable cells
properties.text: Render a recognizable waveform, columns or orbit signal through tiny stable cells, preserving the visible unlit matrix, individual cell edges, dark gutters and a slight perspective skew. The graphic must read as one signal at distance and structured cells close up.

properties.label: Cool green-to-cyan phosphor
properties.text: Use cool green-to-cyan emission over near-black, with restrained glow and darker unlit cells. Keep a strong separation between fixed white labels and the luminous field.

properties.label: Registered cells with evolving signal
properties.text: Evolve the signal from one shared clock while every cell and reading anchor remains registered. Wave, Columns and Orbit must produce distinctly different geometry; density changes the matrix. Pause and reduced motion hold a composed state.

properties.label: Technical serif and mono signal type
properties.text: Use a large technical statement with restrained serif emphasis, plus a small mono eyebrow and exact fixed labels that stay registered while the signal changes.

properties.label: Phosphor cell rendering check
properties.text: Inspect fine cell separation and broader emission independently at delivered DPR. Reject moire, flicker, shimmering gutters and modes without substantial visual change; the field must not cover its controls.
